hypotheses.claim: Clicking the purple square (magenta center) on the diagonal line moves it along the line toward the white diamond or the ring target.
Clicking the purple square again pulls it to the gray anchor diamond; possibly then it launches toward the ring.
W and G are the two ends of a rope; the purple square sits at their midpoint. Clicking a black-field point moves W there; G repositions to keep a minimum gap (~6) from W. Clicking on G swaps W and G.

target_binding.description: W=white diamond, G=gray diamond, square=purple/magenta midpoint, ring=purple target at (21,39)
